description: Exact raw log and receipt bytes for an explicit admin-session-* job list. Every log matches its own result receipt. Separate runs, failures, signals, dirty states and skipped tests remain visible. This is evidence packaging, not a new test run or release acceptance.
limits: Only completed saved receipts are admitted. Hash validation cannot establish continuous filesystem/process provenance. Secret-pattern scanning is bounded and does not replace human review. Missing provenance snapshots remain missing. No browser evidence is inferred from test/build output.
futureRuns: Invoke with a distinct --archive raw-*.json name and an explicit --jobs comma-separated list. Existing archives are never rewritten; byte-identical receipt files are retained without writing, differing files cause refusal.
decoding: Decode runs[i].log.bytesBase64 or artifacts[i].bytesBase64 with Buffer.from(value,'base64'); verify byteLength and SHA256 (plus receiptLogSha256 for a log); write bytes directly with writeFileSync(newAbsolutePath,bytes,{flag:'wx'}), not shell text redirection. Generator source is embedded in generator.bytesBase64 and can be reconstructed the same way.
